# Miras AI

> Miras AI is a US-registered product engineering and AI company headquartered in Bloomington, Indiana, with delivery operations in Lahore, Pakistan.

Miras AI serves founders, CTOs, product leaders and agencies. Its capabilities include product and platform engineering, React Native mobile systems, applied AI and automation, multilingual speech and language data, and fractional engineering leadership.

The company works across more than 45 South Asian languages. Public examples include Urdu, Punjabi, Sindhi, Pashto, Saraiki and Balochi. Language-data work can include speaker recruitment, collection, transcription, annotation and quality assurance.

## Engagement facts

- Technical assessments commonly take 2–4 weeks.
- Focused releases commonly take 4–12 weeks.
- Defined first product releases commonly take 6–16 weeks, depending on scope and dependencies.
- Engagements include defined projects, focused workstreams, delivery pods, embedded engineering teams, white-label delivery and fractional CTO support.
- Miras AI aims to answer qualified project enquiries within one business day.

## Important attribution

Case studies on the Work page describe prior engineering experience of Miras AI's CTO. The named products were developed by their respective companies and are not presented as products built by Miras AI.
